title_en: Opportunity!! At Art in the neighborhood, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect layout and orientation!!
description_en: Bargain price! At the former Profarma, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect layout and orientation!! The apartment has a total area of ​​75.9 m2 and is organized with a corridor that divides the living room and kitchen with access to the balcony, bedroom and toilet. The apartment is located in a qualified and new area in terms of infrastructure, as well as a contemporary project with recreational spaces. The construction has just started and is expected to be completed within 2 years.
